control_flow: In followLine: if LLIGHT is below 50 %, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line through its curves to the green goal at its end without leaving the line.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 50 %

branches.outcome: the left light sensor reads below 50 %: it curves left
the left light sensor reads 50 % or more: it curves right

scenarios.coded_response: Because the left light sensor reads bright, it always curves right; a black line does not change the light sensor.
scenarios.initial_condition: A black line runs from the robot's start, through curves, to a green goal area at its end, in bright light.
scenarios.title: Follows the line to the green goal
assumptions: The whole line is in bright light.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the black line through the curves and reaches the green goal without leaving the line.

scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in dim light inside a tunnel, with nothing in front of it.
scenarios.trigger: The left light sensor reads below 50 %.
scenarios.title: Curves left in dim light
assumptions: You didn't say what the robot should do in dim light.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It keeps turning left while the light stays dim.

uncertainties: Your program reads the left light sensor, not the line tracker, so a black line does not change what it does.
In bright light it always curves right, so on a plain floor it circles right instead of following a line.
The left light sensor is below 50 % only in dim light, and dim light exists only inside a tunnel in the simulator.
You didn't say anything about tunnels or dim light.
